B.ties_how: E216's registered ties on this card (cycles and seconds 0.005 in ln, joules 0.01, watts points 0.1 W)

bands_rule: per arm T1 (wall cycles), T2 (the counter's mean), T3 (seconds), E1 (J over idle given t), E2 (J over idle with t forecast), E3 (J at rest given t), E4 (J at rest with t forecast): MM1-v3.3 within its band at 90% of its scored cases or points; TOO FEW under 10; time at time-scored points only (family P's zeros and pattern points share the random twin's time case: energy only); points under 3 W over idle scored in watts in E1 and E2 (the arm's watts band)
head_to_head_test: per case (time) or point (energy) d = |ln(measured / second)| - |ln(measured / first)| (at a watts point |W - second| - |W - first| in W; J at rest given t: d on ln((rest + W measured) / (rest + W given t)) with the run's own measured rest); FIRST closer when d > the arm's tie (cycles 0.005 in ln; joules 0.01 in ln; watts 0.05 W on arm A, 0.1 W on arm B), SECOND when d < -tie; the exact two-sided sign test over the decided: '<first> BETTER' / '<second> BETTER' at p < 0.05 with at least 8 decided, else NOT DECIDED; TOO FEW under 8 decided; NO DATA with none; NOT APPLICABLE when MM1-v3.3 = MM1-v3.2 (H1-H9). Per arm over the arm's registered points of the scope, and pooled over both arms' (each case with its own arm's tie)
p_rule: FAMILY P's SWITCH-COUNT RULE (E214's and E217's form, Q218's P1-P4), pooled over both arms, REGISTERED for MM1-v3.2 (its switch counts the registered inputs; MM1-v3.3 and every composition REPORTED beside): per pattern point (roles a and b) Q1 e_V = ln(W measured / V), V the model's W given t (with its counts), e_N = ln(W measured / N), N the mean over zeros, ones and random of the same model's W given t at the same measured op time (null_rows), cases with W measured >= 3 W; Q2 E210's metric e_D = [(V - V_R) - (W - W_R)] / D, D = W_R - W_Z measured at the shape's random and zeros twins (V_R the model's W given t at the random twin's own measured op time), for N [(N - V_R) - (W - W_R)] / D, cases with D > 0; P1 rms(Q1 e_V) < rms(e_N); P2 the exact two-sided sign test on d = |e_N| - |e_V| (tie 0.01 in ln), V closer at p < 0.05 with at least 6 decided; P3 rms(Q2 e_D) < N's; P4 P2's test on Q2 (tie 0.01 of D). PASS when P1-P4 hold; FAIL when P1 or P3 fails or a sign test reads N closer at p < 0.05; NOT DECIDED otherwise. Per arm REPORTED.

p_rule_power_REPORTED.how: 2,000 simulated days: every measured W = the truth model's W x exp(N(0, sigma)), the twins likewise
